title: Blue Heron Bliss Cottage & Carriage House | Vacation Home in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
h1: Blue Heron Bliss Cottage & Carriage House
meta_description: Combining the cottage and carriage house into one Blue Heron Bliss features 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths, and 4600 sq.ft. of luxury living. Click now to book your stay!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Blue Heron Bliss Cottage & Carriage House overlooks the beautiful lawn and Town Center of the charming community of Rosemary Beach south of 30A, yet is also a few easy steps down the boardwalk to endless ocean views. New owners of 88 N. Spanish Town Lane have created a spacious paradise for guests with or without children to enjoy. The three-story home resides with its newly renovated exterior with classic Bevelo lantern lighting, and bright, welcoming interiors that feature large design features combined with coastal style, perfect for bringing family and friends together under one roof. With 5 bedrooms - two of which are master suites - 5.5 baths, a private courtyard, wrap around deck and private carriage house, this Rosemary Beach getaway is fitting for both families with small children as well as adults seeking a private beach holiday.

Exquisite details adorn this home from the first floor to the third: vintage iron staircase, large open concept living area, rich hardwood floors, rustic wood beams and water fall feature in the outdoor courtyard. Children can play in the large fenced in patio on the ground floor while adults enjoy the view from the private 2nd floor balcony. The gourmet kitchen is a dream for festive or lazy gatherings in the kitchen, with all the cook’s tools like the comforts of home. Coming in and out from a day at the beach is a breeze with the private shower accessible from the patio through the spacious laundry room and half bath. Blue Heron Bliss is where your next beach vacation memories will be made!

Blue Heron Bliss Carriage House is steps from the beautiful lawn and Town Center of the charming community of Rosemary Beach south of 30A, yet is also a few easy steps down the boardwalk to endless ocean views. Cozy interior with den, dining and kitchen areas. Blue Heron Bliss Carriage House is where your next beach vacation memories will be made!

Garage Parking for two vehicles.

**THIS PROPERTY REQUIRES 7 NIGHT STAY SATURDAY - SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER**
